notes.title: Buy now Stargaze with up to 80% off!
notes.content:
Played With Fire HQ is located in Kraków (Cracow), one of the past capital of Poland. We're proudly supporting Polish Constitution Days 2024 on Steam with other developers and publishers from our country. It's great to be part of one of the most impactful and important game development regions in the world.

We believe video games should share same values as people and countries - individual rights, freedom of speech, diversity, safety and peace. To celebrate Constitutional Days in Poland worldwide, we're discounting Stargaze, our debut VR game. We hope you will enjoy freedom of Stargazer, passion for discovery, and love for foreign life.

notes.title: Mixture demo is now available!
notes.content:
Hi Knights & Alchemists! 🔥

We’ve just released a Mixture demo during Steam Next Fest: February 2024 Edition! It’s the first time you can try and enjoy our unique dual character control game where you are both: Alchemist & Knight. In the first person, you control Alchemist Sephairos. While seeing the world in the third person, you are the Steel Moth Knight Sola.

Platform, mix materials, cast and melee, solve puzzles, and defeat giant bosses to survive this atmospheric tale on your way to redemption! ⚔️

[b]PLAY THE DEMO NOW! 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133890/Mixture/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133890/Mixture/[/url][/b]

We can’t wait to hear what you like in the game, what has surprised you, and what have you experienced for the first time in VR thanks to Mixture! If you want to share your feedback or ask us anything, feel free to post in Steam community, follow us on social media, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/YTQJJUex5f]Discord[/url] community! ❤️

Watch the trailer:
[previewyoutube=vRBMSTLTT14;full][/previewyoutube]

See you in the Wastelands!

notes.title: "Mixture" on UploadVR Showcase
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777093/e526d0dac825f79469d2da547332d69235f64d79.png[/img]

Hello VR Fans!

We have thrilling news for all enthusiasts of our game "Mixture"! This coming Wednesday, December 6th, we will be unveiling a brand-new trailer and announcing the official release date for the game on the PCVR platform at the upcoming UploadVR Showcase event.

This trailer will be packed with fresh details, breathtaking moments, and, of course, a few surprises we’ve been keeping under wraps. Get ready for a fully immersive experience that will take you into a new dimension of VR gameplay.

Don't miss this unique opportunity to see what we've been working on for "Mixture"! Join us at the UploadVR Showcase and be among the first to find out when you can dive into our VR world.

Follow us on Steam and social media for the latest news and updates. We look forward to seeing you this Wednesday!

Best Regards,
Played With Fire Team
